executions.conversation_summary: The discussion concerns payment service 504 errors beginning around 14:15 UTC. Participants ruled out database resource issues, third-party gateway downtime, and AWS backbone network degradation, concluding that requests stalled between the edge ingress and the payment core.

suggestions.text: Auth-proxy connection pool metrics show saturation at 14:15 — active connections hit the configured max, queue depth spiked to 2.3k, and acquire latency jumped from <5 ms to >2 s, which directly precedes the downstream 504 cascade.
suggestions.rationale: Grounds the stall in observable pool telemetry without assigning blame, matching the technical, concise style requested.

suggestions.text: Correlating the pool exhaustion timestamp with the payment-core timeout logs shows a 99% overlap — every 504 correlates to a thread blocked on auth-proxy connection acquisition.
suggestions.rationale: Provides an alternative data-driven angle linking the pool metrics to the observed errors, useful if the group wants tighter correlation evidence.
